briefdescription.para: Basic blocks that are contained in the cycle, including entry blocks, and including blocks that are part of a child cycle.
The parent cycle.

detaileddescription.para: Is null for the root "cycle". Top-level cycles point at the root.

briefdescription.para: The entry block(s) of the cycle.

detaileddescription.para: The header is the only entry if this is a loop. Is empty for the root "cycle", to avoid unnecessary memory use.

briefdescription.para: Child cycles, if any.
Depth of the cycle in the tree.

simplesect.para: Depths are not necessarily contiguous. However, child loops always have strictly greater depth than their parents, and sibling loops always have the same depth.

briefdescription.para: Cache for the results of GetExitBlocks.
Whether the cycle is a natural loop.
Clear the cache of the cycle.

detaileddescription.para: This should be run in all non-const function in GenericCycle and GenericCycleInfo.

briefdescription.para: Return whether Block is an entry block of the cycle.
Replace all entries with Block as single entry.
Return whether Block is contained in the cycle.
Returns true iff this cycle contains C.

detaileddescription.para: Note: Non-strict containment check, i.e. returns true if C is the same cycle.

briefdescription.para: Return all of the successor blocks of this cycle.

detaileddescription.para: These are the blocks outside of the current cycle which are branched to.

briefdescription.para: Return all blocks of this cycle that have successor outside of this cycle.

detaileddescription.para: These blocks have cycle exit branch.

briefdescription.para: Return the preheader block for this cycle.

detaileddescription.para: Pre-header is well-defined for reducible cycle in docs/LoopTerminology.rst as: the only one entering block and its only edge is to the entry block. Return null for irreducible cycles.

briefdescription.para: If the cycle has exactly one entry with exactly one predecessor, return it, otherwise return nullptr.
Verify that this is actually a well-formed cycle in the CFG.
Verify the parent-child relations of this cycle.

detaileddescription.para: Note that this does not check that cycle is really a cycle in the CFG.
